div.p: Ten Wellness was founded with a mission to redefine wellness in Kuwait. Inspired by years of exploring world-class spa practices, the founders envisioned a space that not only combined exceptional techniques and therapeutic treatments but also addressed deeper layers of well-being. Every service is designed to ensure guest satisfaction and guarantee holistic treatment, offering a serene and rejuvenating journey to restore mind and body.

In July 2017, Yousef and Bader Alessa acquired Ten Wellness and transformed it into a sanctuary of relaxation, rejuvenation, and emotional healing. At Ten Wellness, the focus goes beyond physical care; it embraces the profound connection between body and mind, offering treatments designed to release emotional tension and foster a sense of inner peace.

Today, Ten Wellness stands as a leading destination for wellness, offering unparalleled services that promote balance, healing, and tranquility — empowering guests to renew both their physical and emotional well-being.
A few gentle guidelines to preserve the tranquil atmosphere we cherish for all guests.
